subsystems.name: Engineered microbial strain
subsystems.role: the living factory — a yeast, bacterium or fungus reprogrammed to make one target molecule.
parts: host organism (often baker's yeast or a filamentous fungus)

subsystems.name: Seed train
subsystems.role: grows a tiny frozen culture step by step into enough cells to inoculate the main vessel.
parts: a ladder of progressively larger seed bioreactors

subsystems.name: Production bioreactor
subsystems.role: where the cells multiply and secrete the product, typically fed-batch over several days.
parts: agitator and sparger for oxygen transfer

subsystems.name: Downstream processing
subsystems.role: separates the molecule from cells, water and spent medium.
parts: centrifuge or membrane for cell separation

subsystems.name: Utilities and containment
subsystems.role: keeps the process sterile, clean and safe.

subsystems.name: Process control and analytics
subsystems.role: holds thousands of variables steady and spots contamination early.

buildSteps.title: Choose the molecule and host
buildSteps.detail: The target protein's gene is designed, codon-optimised for the chosen microbe, and inserted along with control elements that switch production on.

buildSteps.title: Engineer and screen strains
buildSteps.detail: Hundreds to thousands of variants are grown in microtitre plates, then the best are improved by rounds of mutation and selection, or adaptive laboratory evolution.

buildSteps.title: Run a pilot seed train
buildSteps.detail: A frozen vial is thawed into a flask, then into 10 L, 100 L and 1,000 L seed vessels, each step multiplying the cell count until the production vessel can be inoculated.

buildSteps.title: Build the fermentation hall
buildSteps.detail: Vessels of tens of cubic metres are installed with agitation, aeration, cooling, sterilisation-in-place and clean-in-place pipework; food-grade production needs hygienic design and filtered air.

buildSteps.title: Prepare and sterilise medium
buildSteps.detail: Sugar or other feedstock, nitrogen, salts and vitamins are mixed and heat-sterilised, then fed in controlled doses as the culture grows.

buildSteps.title: Ferment
buildSteps.detail: Temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen and feed rate are held in narrow bands for days; at peak cell density and product titre the broth is harvested.

buildSteps.title: Recover and purify
buildSteps.detail: Cells are spun or filtered out, the liquid is concentrated, and chromatography or precipitation removes remaining impurities to the purity the market requires.

buildSteps.title: Dry, formulate, approve
buildSteps.detail: The product is dried or liquid-formulated, then cleared under food or pharmaceutical rules before sale.

buildSteps.title: Operate at district scale
buildSteps.detail: A city-scale plant sits near renewable power, uses recovered heat, and treats its wastewater — gas-fermenting strains can instead be fed hydrogen and captured carbon dioxide.

prerequisites.why: antibiotic and enzyme production already runs in vessels of a few hundred cubic metres, proving the hardware.

prerequisites.tech: Genetic engineering and synthetic biology toolkits
prerequisites.why: gene synthesis, CRISPR-based editing and pathway design are what turn a microbe into a production host.
sugar, or hydrogen and captured CO2, must be affordable and clean for the product to compete.
chromatography is far too expensive for commodity protein; cheaper separation is the main barrier.
approval regimes exist in some regions but are slow and differ between countries.

pathway.milestone: high-value molecules — recombinant chymosin for cheese since 1990, recombinant human insulin since 1982, industrial enzymes
pathway.unlocks: a working industrial base and decades of scale-up experience.

pathway.milestone: food proteins such as whey and egg equivalents enter mainstream products
pathway.unlocks: replacing some animal agriculture with far less land and water use.

pathway.milestone: gas fermentation using hydrogen and captured CO2 as feedstock
pathway.unlocks: protein production decoupled from sugar crops and from weather.

pathway.milestone: urban plants drawing on organic waste, waste heat and surplus renewable power
pathway.unlocks: resilient local protein and chemical supply for large cities.
